children: Soluna announced CEO John Belizaire will speak at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference.
John Belizaire will participate in the panel "Powering The AI Boom & Bitcoin Network" on Sept 14, 2026 at 2:00 PM ET.
Conference runs Sept 14–16, 2026 in New York, providing investor visibility into Soluna's digital infrastructure strategy.
Participation underscores Soluna's focus on renewable-powered data centers for Bitcoin mining and AI compute.
Investors can schedule meetings via H.C. Wainwright representatives during the event.
